title: How Priyanka Chopra Jonas Built a Global Business Empire Worth Over ₹580 Crore
excerpt: From Bollywood to boardrooms, the actress-turned-entrepreneur has assembled a portfolio spanning haircare, production, luxury investments, and real estate across two continents — capped by the recent sale of her brand to Reliance.
body:

  • Her portfolio includes production, luxury investments, and real estate in two continents.
  • Combined with Nick Jonas, their estimated wealth is approximately ₹1,250 crore.

  • Priyanka Chopra Jonas’s personal net worth is estimated at approximately ₹583 crore (around $70 million), built across entertainment, brand equity, and business ownership
  • Reliance recently acquired her haircare brand Anomaly, gaining full ownership of the brand’s intellectual property and digital ecosystem
  • Her portfolio spans Purple Pebble Pictures (production), luxury brand investments including Perfect Moment skiwear, and real estate across Los Angeles and Mumbai
  • Combined with husband Nick Jonas, the couple’s estimated wealth stands at approximately ₹1,250 crore

When Priyanka Chopra Jonas sold her haircare brand Anomaly to Reliance Industries earlier this year, it marked more than a routine business transaction. It signaled the maturation of a model that has become increasingly common among celebrity entrepreneurs: building a brand, owning the intellectual property, creating a consumer community, and then monetizing through a strategic acquisition.

Chopra Jonas’s personal net worth is now estimated at approximately ₹583 crore, according to Koimoi — a fortune assembled not through acting fees alone, but through a deliberate portfolio of businesses, investments, and brand equity that spans two continents.

From Brand Ambassador to Brand Owner

The traditional celebrity endorsement model — being paid to appear in a 30-second advertisement — is a revenue stream Chopra Jonas mastered early. She has endorsed over 40 brands across jewellery, beauty, and fashion, including global campaigns for Bulgari, Victoria’s Secret, Crocs, and The Gap. Indian endorsements have included Garnier, Pepsi, Pantene, and Joyalukkas.

https://x.com/MENAFN/status/2078741985071182054

But the more significant evolution came when she began building brands she owned. In 2021, she launched Anomaly, a haircare line that quickly gained traction in global retail markets. Unlike an endorsement deal, brand ownership creates an appreciating asset — one that can eventually be sold, as it was to Reliance.

The Reliance deal gives the Indian conglomerate full ownership of Anomaly’s intellectual property and digital ecosystem, with plans to scale the brand through its retail network and beauty platform Tira.

The Portfolio

Chopra Jonas’s business interests extend well beyond haircare. Her production company, Purple Pebble Pictures, has backed projects across Indian languages and global markets. She has invested in consumer and technology companies including Perfect Moment, a luxury skiwear brand, and Genies, a virtual avatar company. She was instrumental in launching the dating app Bumble in India.

Her earlier venture, SONA — a contemporary Indian restaurant in New York — and its lifestyle offshoot SONA Home represented an attempt to build businesses around Indian culture and identity. Though her partnership with SONA ended in 2023 and the restaurant later closed, the pattern was clear: converting cultural capital into commercial ownership.

“A traditional brand ambassador monetises fame. A celebrity entrepreneur attempts to convert fame into ownership.”

— Exchange4Media analysis

Real Estate and Lifestyle

The real estate portfolio is substantial. In 2019, Chopra Jonas and husband Nick Jonas purchased a $20 million mansion in Encino, Los Angeles — a 20,000-square-foot property with seven bedrooms. She owns a New York City apartment estimated at $5-6 million, a sea-facing bungalow in Mumbai’s Juhu worth an estimated ₹70 crore, and a beachfront villa in Goa valued at ₹15-20 crore.

In recent years, she has been consolidating her Indian real estate holdings. In 2025, she sold two Mumbai apartments in Lokhandwala for ₹16.17 crore, following earlier sales of property in the same locality. The moves suggest a strategic rebalancing toward her Los Angeles base.

![Purple Pebble Pictures. › Production company: Purple Pebble Pictures.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/en/4/4f/Purple_Pebble_Pictures_Logo.jpg)

What Sets This Apart

Combined with Nick Jonas’s estimated wealth of ₹666 crore — drawn from his music career with the Jonas Brothers, solo projects, and acting — the couple’s total fortune stands at approximately ₹1,250 crore. Chopra Jonas contributes roughly 46.6% of the combined total.

What makes her wealth story distinctive within the Indian diaspora is the shift from fame-as-currency to fame-as-equity. She is not merely the richest Bollywood actress abroad; she has built a model for how Indian-origin cultural figures can create lasting commercial value in global markets — a playbook that younger NRI entrepreneurs and entertainers are beginning to follow.
